format: Descriptive contract; this file contains no experimental result rows.

document.cases: Array of exactly 100 cases in original audit evaluation order.
document.expected: Object with statistics and conditions, copied from the independently audited result.

case.case_index: Integer 0 through 99, equal to this row's array index.
case.arms: Object with exactly B0, S, E0, E1, E2; every arm belongs to this same case.

arm_fields.first_unique_turn: Integer 1 through 25, or null if unresolved.
arm_fields.queries: Actual actor query count; equals first_unique_turn when resolved, otherwise 25.
arm_fields.invalid: Number of malformed query outputs, counted as consumed queries.
arm_fields.truncated: Number of actor outputs whose finish reason was length.
arm_fields.information_bits: Sum of realized log2(before/after) over valid queries; descriptive mechanism statistic.
arm_fields.input_tokens: Total actor input tokens for this episode.
arm_fields.output_tokens: Total actor output tokens for this episode.

derived.penalized26: first_unique_turn when resolved, otherwise the assigned penalty 26.
derived.primary: Paired case mean of average(E0,E1,E2) capped25 minus B0 capped25; negative favors adaptation.
derived.bootstrap: 10000 shared paired-case resamples; Python random.Random(62026), randrange(N) for each of N draws; percentile interpolation. All arms and chains remain paired.
derived.resolution_curve: Cumulative number identified by each turn 1 through 25, including all 100 cases.

ordering: Never sort by outcome or use original case IDs. Preserve the audit row order in every arm so the seeded bootstrap reproduces exactly.
excluded: No original case IDs, labels, guesses, transcripts, paths, job IDs, receipts, or authorization/deployment material. Extra document, case, and arm fields are rejected.
expected_mapping: expected.statistics = audit.statistics; expected.conditions = audit.conditions. For index i, each arms[arm] is the eight allowed fields copied from audit.cases[arm][i].
limits: Verifies arithmetic and anonymous pairing only. Intervals condition on three realized chains sharing eighteen training cases. Information gain among valid queries is descriptive, not a causal conditional effect.
